title: Rise of the Titans: A Dusty, Hyper-luminous “870 μm Riser” Galaxy at z ∼ 6
question: Is ADFS-27, an extremely red '870 um riser' selected from Herschel/SPIRE and LABOCA, a very high-redshift dusty starburst, and what are its redshift, gas content, and merger/starburst properties?

data.bands: 870 um continuum (343 GHz LO); 3 mm scan 84.077–113.280 GHz
data.angular_resolution: 870 um: 0.20x0.17 (natural), 0.17x0.14 arcsec (robust 0.5); 3 mm continuum: 3.13x2.36 and 2.48x1.86 arcsec
data.sensitivity: 870 um: 99 and 108 uJy/beam; 3 mm continuum: 11.2 and 13.6 uJy/beam

what.value: Average SMG CO(6-5)/(5-4) ratio r65=0.66 for comparison

evidence.quote: average value for SMGs within the uncertainties ($r_{65}$=0.66; (cite: bothwell13))
assuming the average CO($J$=5$\to$4)/CO($J$=1$\to$0) line brightness temperature ratio for SMGs of $r_{51}$=0.39 (cite: cw13)

what.value: Dust absorption coefficient 2.64 m2/kg at 125 um

evidence.quote: Assuming a dust absorption coefficient of $\kappa_\nu$=2.64 m$^2$kg$^{-1}$ at 125 $\mu$m (cite: dunne03)

what.value: HFLS3 MAGPHYS-based SED template used for stellar mass limit

evidence.quote: normalizing the MAGPHYS-based SED template of HFLS3 in Fig. [4](#f4) to the observed-frame 4.5 $\mu$m limit
which is 5.9, 6.3, and 6.8 mJy (1$\sigma$) at 250, 350, and 500 $\mu$m, respectively (cite: nguyen10)

recipe.method: CLEAN with natural and robust 0.5 weighting in CASA

recipe.goal: Measure continuum flux densities and sizes
recipe.method: Two-dimensional Gaussian fitting of the two components

recipe.goal: Find lines and measure redshift and line properties
recipe.method: Search 3 mm sweep; Gaussian fits to line profiles for flux, FWHM; unique redshift solution

recipe.goal: Fit SED for dust temperature, L_IR, dust mass, SFR
recipe.method: Modified blackbody plus blue power law, optically thin and general (optical depth) models, affine-invariant MCMC, 500 um flux as normalization
assumptions: kappa=2.64 m2/kg at 125 um; Chabrier IMF

recipe.goal: Derive molecular gas mass, gas-to-dust, depletion time
recipe.method: L'CO(1-0) from CO(5-4) with r51=0.39, times alpha_CO

recipe.goal: Derive surface densities, dynamical masses, alpha_CO limit
recipe.method: Sizes and flux ratio from 870 um; isotropic virial estimator with radii x1.5; common linewidth
assumptions: 100% of dynamical mass is molecular gas for alpha_CO upper limit

evidence.quote: we obtain a unique (median) redshift solution at $z$=5.6550$\pm$0.0001
separated by 1.49$''$ in the high-resolution 870 $\mu$m data

answer_key.quantity: SFR surface densities N and S

evidence.loc: 3.3 Star Formation Rate and Gas Surface Densities
evidence.quote: SFR surface densities of $\Sigma_{\rm SFR}$=730 and 750 $M_{\odot}$ yr$^{-1}$ kpc$^{-2}$

evidence.loc: 3.3 Star Formation Rate and Gas Surface Densities

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channel selection and continuum subtraction approach
CLEAN threshold, masking, cell and image size
Self-calibration status and whether pipeline or manual calibration was used
Rest frequencies used for the lines
MCMC priors, sampler settings and SFR/L_IR conversion
Details of Gaussian fitting for component flux densities and sizes
Method to derive redshift solution and dynamical mass numbers (adopted linewidth)
missing_for_reproduction: Exact flux extraction procedure for components
score_reason: Data IDs, CASA version, weighting and beams given, but imaging and fitting details sparse.
rediscovery_reason: Archive ALMA data, numeric results (flux, line fluxes, redshift) can be re-measured, though SED and mass steps need assumptions.
